Tour itinerary

  1. Stop 1Kandy to Huluganga

    Hotel pickup in Kandy and a drive through Wattegama to the Huluganga viewpoint.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  2. Stop 2Alakola and Sari Ella

    Walk to the falls and ask your guide about swimming conditions at Sari Ella.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  3. Stop 3Jodu and Lebanon Ella

    Explore the forest and tea-country viewpoints.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  4. Stop 4Picnic and return

    Stop for a picnic lunch and return to your Kandy hotel after the final stops.

    Find this stop on the map ↗

Trip details
